facts.fact: The national employment agency Techghil launched three AI-based digital platforms matching job seekers with employers on 26 November 2026, per the Mauritanian news agency via Madar.

MRT.note: Job-matching platforms are general administration, not a listed sector's system.
No locally built model, dataset or AI computing stated.
Specialised service offers for persons with disabilities are named, but nothing on accessible information or digital services.
Who built or runs the platforms is not stated.
